text: {"answerable":true,"answer":"The error indicates the IdP signing certificate has rotated. Re‑import the IdP metadata or enable auto‑refresh from the metadata URL to resolve the issue. If auto‑refresh is disabled, the rotation will break every login immediately. Meridian caches IdP metadata for 24 hours, so with auto‑refresh you would normally pick up the new certificate within that window. The error returns HTTP 401 and is not retryable.","citations":["S1","S2","S3","S4"],"confidence":0.9,"missing_information":"","injection_suspected":false}
